# `csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar`

Put a broken parameter list's ) on its own line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar = true`

```ini
csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Move(
        int x,
        int y)
    {
    }

    public void Resize(
        int width,
        int height
    )
    {
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Move(
        int x,
        int y
    )
    {
    }

    public void Resize(
        int width,
        int height
    )
    {
    }
}
```
:::

::::
